ex.t: 然而，猫区分不同情况的另一种方式是寻找熟悉的气味。

ex.s: After I read the book, Taylor patiently answered my questions about it.
ex.t: 我读完那本书后，泰勒耐心地回答了我关于它的问题。

ex.s: What can we learn about the author soon after he moved to London?
ex.t: 关于作者刚搬到伦敦后不久我们能了解到什么？

defs.def: in the style of sb/sth; following the example of sb/sth 模仿；依照
happening or done later than the time or event mentioned 构成形容词

ex.s: After that, critics used the word kowtow when anyone was too submissive to China.
ex.t: 在英语中，gung-ho是一个形容词，意思是极度兴奋地想做某事。

defs.def: despite what has been said or expected 毕竟；终归

ex.s: After all, I had left him little choice.
ex.t: 毕竟，我几乎没给他留下什么选择。

ex.s: After all, I did care about how others would think of me.
ex.t: 毕竟，我确实在意别人会怎么看我。

ex.s: It would be impossible to progress in anything, after all, without taking the occasional misstep.
ex.t: 毕竟，不偶尔走错步，任何事都不可能进步。

ex.s: After all, nature does not require our patience, but our action.
ex.t: 毕竟，自然不需要我们的耐心，而是需要我们的行动。

ex.s: My faith in human nature has never been so great as it was last weekend after our family get-together in the town of Vail.
ex.t: 我对人性的信心从未像上周末在韦尔镇家庭聚会后那样强烈。

ex.s: I  41  the idea of taking the class because, after all, who doesn’t want to  42  a few dollars?
ex.t: 我___41___上课的主意，因为毕竟谁不想___42___几美元呢？

ex.s: After all, if we adapt in that way, we may avoid the need to change in so many others.
ex.t: 毕竟，如果我们以这种方式适应，也许就不需要在其他方面做出如此多的改变了。

ex.s: “After all, everyone has bad days and good days," he said.
ex.t: "毕竟，每个人都有好日子和坏日子，"他说。

ex.s: After all, he had done his best
ex.t: 毕竟，他已经尽了最大努力

defs.def: （解释或说明理由）别忘了，到底

ex.s: Directions: After reading the passages below, fill in the blanks to make the passages coherent and grammatically correct.
ex.t: 说明：阅读下面短文后，填空使短文连贯。

defs.def: to be going to do sth soon; to be intending to do sth soon 正要做某事；打算就要做某事

ex.s: Who will look after the children?
ex.t: 谁来照看孩子们？

ex.s: Who will look after the children?
ex.t: 谁来照看孩子们？

ex.s: While going through the pages, he kept saying, wide-eyed: “How can there be this many words?” After a while, he looked at me and asked, “Do you know all these words, Mom?” I smiled, “I definitely do not know all these words,” I said.
ex.t: 他翻着书页，睁大眼睛不停地说：“怎么会有这么多词？”过了一会儿，他看着我问：“妈妈，你认识所有这些词吗？”我笑着说：“我确实不认识所有这些词。”

defs.def: to have just done sth 刚做了某事

ex.s: What did Jennifer do after high school? （    ）
ex.t: 珍妮弗高中毕业后做了什么？（    ）

ex.s: What did the students do after they learned about the birth of Gordon?
ex.t: 学生们了解到戈登出生后做了什么？

ex.s: What did John do after he moved to the US?
ex.t: 约翰搬到美国后做了什么？
